purpose: Machine-readable summary of the tiered consensus-resolution algorithm applied to the three-model Layer 1 base classifications.

tiers.label: Full Consensus
tiers.rule: All three base models return identical values for every categorical field.

tiers.label: Majority Agreement, Non-Critical Fields
tiers.rule: Two of three models agree on all fields; dissent is limited to non-critical fields.

tiers.label: Majority Agreement, Critical Fields
tiers.rule: Two of three models agree on outcome / primary_claim_type / claim_types but one model dissents.

tiers.label: Three-Way Split, Non-Critical → Haiku 4.5
tiers.rule: All three models return different values for non-critical fields with no majority.
tiers.action: Submit to Anthropic Haiku 4.5 (Batch API) with original case text and each model's answer for disputed fields.

tiers.label: Three-Way Split, Critical → Sonnet 4.6
tiers.rule: All three models return different values for outcome / primary_claim_type / claim_types.
tiers.action: Submit to Anthropic Sonnet 4.6 (Batch API) with original case text and each model's answer; Sonnet also re-extracts four free-text narrative fields fresh from source.

free_text_resolution_rules.tier_4_records: Sonnet 4.6 re-extracts free-text fields from source.
free_text_resolution_rules.all_other_records: MiniMax M2.7 free-text version is adopted (most detailed extractions among the three base classifiers).

tier_3_minimax_tiebreaker_noncritical.note: earlier-pipeline tier-3 used MiniMax tiebreaker; later switched to Haiku 4.5 for the unified RA database

tier_4_minimax_tiebreaker_critical.note: earlier-pipeline tier-4 used MiniMax tiebreaker; later switched to Sonnet 4.6 for the unified RA database

implementation.published_copy: method/pipeline/java/mfh/gfo/ (credential-redacted as-run copies; provenance in method/pipeline/java/README.md)
implementation.origin_repository: MFH-Java-Work (author's private working repository; copied at commit e5c6d60, 2026-04-28)
implementation.note: Class names follow the published method/pipeline/java/ sources; the naming note in method/pipeline/java/README.md resolves documentation references to these files. Merge/consensus into the unified database: scripts/build_unified_db.py.

scope_note: This adjudication algorithm governs the general-pipeline categorical fields. Mechanism-family classification (TRANSLATION / PROCEDURAL_GATEWAY / NO_FAILURE / OTHER on the 676-case T4 pleading-loss universe) is produced by a separate three-model majority-vote ensemble (Kimi K2.6 + GLM-5.1 + DeepSeek V3.2) without Haiku/Sonnet adjudication; see Layer 2 in method/pipeline/model_metadata.json.
